title: Shift coherence of scalar operation comparisons
statement: Let l be prime. Coefficient fields are finite extensions of Q_l with specified Q_l-algebra embeddings. Use the actual completed coefficient sheaves and raw rationalizations of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] and [def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. Schemes supporting a constructible rational category are assumed noetherian, finite-dimensional, with l invertible; ambient operation comparisons are for arbitrary scheme morphisms g : X → Y in the actual ambient derived categories. For a finite coefficient-field embedding and a scheme morphism, the specified direct-image, ordinary-pullback and completed-pullback scalar comparison transformations commute with integer shifts, using the counit-normalized derived scalar shift structures and the fixed operation shift structures.

source.place: Order 1307; existing scalar-extension component, relocated without changing signatures or proofs.

proof.text: The ordinary scalar-pullback comparison is normalized on flat-term K-flat resolutions by the ordinary tensor isomorphism. Its two derived counit routes commute with shifts. Density of these resolutions detects the shift equation of the derived comparison.

The direct-image mate is the composite of the derived adjunction unit, the pushforward of the ordinary pull comparison, and the pushed-forward scalar counit. The normalized derived-adjunction theorem makes each factor shift-compatible; composition and whiskering preserve compatibility.

The unit-normalized completion comparison commutes with shifts by uniqueness of maps into complete objects. Compose its inverse with the ordinary pull comparison to obtain the completed-pull shift equation.
